description: This file defines the interface IControlService for the Rialto server control service, including method declarations for control management, acknowledgment, application state setting, and ping functionality.

classes.name: IControlService
classes.description: An interface class for control service operations in the Rialto server.

methods.name: addControl
methods.description: Adds a control identified by controlId with the specified client.

methods.name: removeControl
methods.description: Removes the control identified by controlId.

methods.name: ack
methods.description: Acknowledges a control message with the given controlId and message id.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Checks connectivity by sending a ping with the specified id and ackSender.
